MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON: normal volatility at 33.0% and broad participation, with 7/8 sectors positive over one week. Breadth is supportive, though several sectors remain negative over one month.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Transportation leads in ABOVE TREND, with sector returns of 1W: +6.44% and 1M: +15.28%; PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) is ABOVE TREND. Construction & REIT is in RECOVERY (1W: +3.99% | 1M: -2.74%), while Banking & Finance is ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +4.29%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Holding & Investment is the sole negative sector on both horizons, in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -2.64%). Retail & Food is in RECOVERY but weakly so (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -7.51%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) is ABOVE TREND; CCOLA (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -0.93%) is RECOVERY; TCELL (1W: +7.78% | 1M: -1.32%) is RECOVERY. KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%) is RECOVERY; ALARK (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +0.74%) is ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
ULKER (1W: -9.37% | 1M: -8.09%), SOKM (1W: -7.06% | 1M: -23.17%), DOHOL (1W: -6.38% | 1M: -6.69%), HEKTS (1W: -4.55% | 1M: -20.38%) and ARCLK (1W: -2.92% | 1M: -11.04%) are all BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) is ABOVE TREND; CCOLA (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -0.93%), TCELL (1W: +7.78% | 1M: -1.32%), KRDMD (1W: +7.58% | 1M: -9.87%) and ALARK (1W: +7.17% | 1M: +0.74%) are in RECOVERY, RECOVERY, RECOVERY and ABOVE TREND, respectively.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is ABOVE TREND at sector level, with 1W: +2.07% and 1M: +4.29%; GARAN (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.17%) is ABOVE TREND. AKBNK (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +4.25%), ISCTR (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +4.15%) and YKBNK (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +5.12%) are also ABOVE TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is in RECOVERY at sector level (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -7.44%). EREGL (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -11.86%) is RECOVERY; FROTO (1W: +0.82% | 1M: +2.64%) is ABOVE TREND; ASELS (1W: +4.14% | 1M: -0.72%) is RECOVERY.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
The sector is in RECOVERY, with 1W: +0.80% against 1M: -13.35%; TUPRS (1W: +6.37% | 1M: -8.18%) and SISE (1W: +4.73% | 1M: -4.17%) are RECOVERY. Weakness remains evident in HEKTS (1W: -4.55% | 1M: -20.38%), which is BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a measured risk-on stance, favoring sectors with positive returns across both horizons, particularly transportation and banking. Keep exposure selective: broad weekly participation contrasts with persistent one-month weakness in several sectors.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Monitor PGSUS (1W: +9.68% | 1M: +19.74%) and THYAO (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +14.68%), both ABOVE TREND, for continuation; watch GARAN (1W: +4.16% | 1M: +15.17%), also ABOVE TREND. CCOLA (1W: +9.62% | 1M: -0.93%) is RECOVERY and needs follow-through to confirm its rebound.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Transportation is the leader and remains ABOVE TREND; Banking & Finance also holds ABOVE TREND with positive returns over both horizons. Track whether Construction & REIT can extend its RECOVERY, with 1W: +3.99% versus 1M: -2.74%.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
XU100 spot levels and technical support/resistance are not provided, so specific index levels cannot be stated. Watch for breadth to hold near 7/8 positive and for one-week gains in recovery sectors to improve their one-month trend.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

BIST is RISK-ON, supported by normal volatility and broad weekly participation, with transportation and banking leading. Favor confirmed ABOVE TREND areas while treating rebounds as selective opportunities; weak one-month performance across several sectors remains the key risk.
